title: Supported completion on modules killed by an ideal power
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let X,Y be algebraic spaces over S [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let f:X→Y be a morphism. Modules and direct image are on their small etale ringed sites [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. Let J,K be quasi-coherent ideals [def-sfb-space-quasi-coherent-ideal], and q≥0. Use coherent modules, J-adic diagrams, the canonical completion functor C_J:H↦(H/J^nH)_{n≥1}, and annihilation by ideal powers as in [def-sfb-space-coherent-adic-system]; coherence means quasi-coherence and coherence on all etale scheme charts [pqf-def-coherent]. A module has proper support over Y if it is i_*Q for a representable closed immersion i:Z→X [def-weil-closed-immersion] with f i proper and Q finite type quasi-coherent, using the proper-carrier convention of [def-sfb-space-proper-quot-functor] and properness of [def-sfb-space-morphism-properties]. Let C be the full subcategory of coherent modules H with proper support over Y and K^qH=0. Let D be the full subcategory of Coh(X,J) with proper first-term support over Y and every term killed by K^q. SupportedKilledAdicCompletionEquivalence(f,J,K,q) means that C_J takes C into D, is bijective on every hom set between objects of C, and every object of D is isomorphic to C_J(H) for some H in C. Thus it is precisely the condition that the specified canonical completion restricts to an equivalence C→D, not the existence of an unrelated equivalence. For q≥1 these are the ambient full subcategories for the closed thickening cut out by K^q, as in Stacks 08BC.
